parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for desc. Allowed: id, parentOrderSn, parentOrderStatus, shippingMethod, expectShipLatestTime, latestDeliveryTime, parentOrderTime, total, currency, created_at, updated_at. Default: -id.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Free-text search across parentOrderSn, Temu order id, and linked SKU sales_order_number.

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Archived state. Accepts: 'all'|'2' (both), 'only'|'archived'|'1'|true (archived only), '' / 'active' / '0' (default — active only).

parameters.name: filter[parentOrderStatus]
parameters.description: Exact match on Temu parent order status enum (e.g. unshipped, shipped, delivered, cancelled, partially_shipped, refunding, refunded).

parameters.name: filter[linked]
parameters.description: true = orders that have a linked SKU sales order, false = orders without one.
